_help: App Icon page specs per platform (Design_System_Intake_Skill section 7h, steps/app-icon.md). Each platform reads only its own block; the platform Main Skill section 5b explains the rules in words. Sizes in px unless the key says pt or dp. Preview masks are for the ➜ App Icon page only and are never baked into exported art.

drop_zones.name: App Icon Drop Zone / Default
drop_zones.accepts: square artwork, fully opaque, no rounded corners, no shadow

drop_zones.name: App Icon Drop Zone / Dark
drop_zones.accepts: dark appearance; transparent background allowed (the system adds the dark background)

drop_zones.name: App Icon Drop Zone / Tinted
drop_zones.accepts: grayscale artwork; the system adds the tint color

ios.code_target: Assets.xcassets/AppIcon.appiconset (Xcode single size: the 1024 image per appearance; the other sizes are previews and legacy exports)
ios.liquid_glass_note: For iOS 26 layered (Liquid Glass) icons, also export the foreground shapes and the background as separate SVG layers for Icon Composer when the user asks.

drop_zones.name: App Icon Drop Zone / Foreground
drop_zones.accepts: transparent background; key shapes inside the 66dp safe circle

drop_zones.name: App Icon Drop Zone / Background
drop_zones.accepts: fully opaque color or image; a Semantic or Palette color is used when empty

drop_zones.name: App Icon Drop Zone / Monochrome
drop_zones.accepts: one flat color on transparent (themed icons, Android 13+); only the shape (alpha) is used

drop_zones.name: App Icon Drop Zone / Play Store
drop_zones.accepts: 512 x 512 full square, 32-bit PNG; generated from the layers when empty

play_store.note: full square, no rounded corners and no shadow (Google Play applies them)

previews: Themed icon in Light and Dark

drop_zones.name: App Icon Drop Zone / Dark
drop_zones.accepts: variant for dark browser UI (used inside icon.svg with prefers-color-scheme)

drop_zones.name: App Icon Drop Zone / Maskable
drop_zones.accepts: full-bleed opaque background; key shapes inside the central circle (80% diameter); generated from Icon when empty

sizes.note: may include a prefers-color-scheme: dark style
opaque, square; iOS rounds the corners
